suite: Medium-Severity Compliance, Indexer Parity & Drift Suite

findings.title: Sub-Unit Integer Truncation in Custody Fee & Micro-Redemption Accounting
findings.root_cause: The custody fee calculation `getFeeFor(value) = value.mul(feeRate).div(feeParts)` (where `feeParts = 1,000,000`) applies integer floor division without a sub-unit remainder accumulator. For transfers where `value < feeParts / feeRate` (e.g. < 5,000 wei for 200 ppm fee rate), the fee truncates to 0 wei. Over 10,000 sequential micro-transactions/redemptions, the cumulative rounding drift creates an unclaimable custody fee shortfall and untracked asset reserves.
findings.regulatory_compliance_impact: As a NYDFS-regulated digital asset issuer, Paxos requires 1:1 physical gold/fiat reserve parity and deterministic fee ledgering. Unbounded cumulative truncation in fee collection leads to reconciliation discrepancies between on-chain gold token balances and off-chain physical vault custody accounting.
findings.remediation: Introduce an integer remainder accumulator for fee reconciliation or enforce a minimum non-zero fee threshold (e.g. `max(1, value.mul(feeRate).div(feeParts))`) for transfers below the truncation boundary.

findings.title: Unbounded Dynamic Memory Array in Administrative Batch Role & Whitelist Setup
findings.root_cause: `SupplyControllerInitialization` and `betaDelegatedTransferBatch` iterate over unconstrained dynamic memory arrays (`address[] mintAddressWhitelist`, `bytes[] sig`, etc.) without an explicit batch size ceiling (`MAX_BATCH_LIMIT`).
findings.regulatory_compliance_impact: During an emergency compliance asset protection event (e.g. OFAC sanction enforcement or court-ordered batch freeze), executing an unbounded batch array could exceed the Ethereum block gas limit (30M gas), causing emergency administrative transactions to revert and failing timely regulatory execution.
findings.remediation: Add an explicit `require(mintAddressWhitelist.length <= MAX_BATCH_SIZE, 'batch too large')` check capping batch operations to a deterministic gas envelope.
